1_executive_summary: P-24 — Gravity-compensating hydraulic damper. Compressible element reduces conductance . A computationally specified P-24 concept plus a preregistered decisive experiment — not a validated technology. Current evidence: T1. Transfer posture: DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED. Recommended transaction: SPONSORED_VALIDATION ($15K bench experiment). Validation cost: $15K.
2_industry_problem: ASD outperforms damper in target-flow matching in 3/4 postures

3_current_alternative.strongest_alternative: Anti-siphon device (ASD) — established clinical track record, binary threshold behavior, outperforms damper in 3/4 modeled postures
3_current_alternative.alternative_weakness: ASD has binary threshold behavior; no proportional alternative exists
3_current_alternative.why_inadequate: Does proportional regulation + faster dynamic response create a meaningful advantage over ASD? Current computational evidence does NOT establish superiority.

7_validation_investment.experiment: Physical bench test: damper vs ASD vs standard shunt, 4 postural pressures (10/20/30/40 mmHg), 10 runs each, blinded analysis. Endpoints: response_time_damper_ms (pass<200ms, fail>1000ms) and proportional_error_pct (pass<15%, fail>30%). 95% two-sided CI.
7_validation_investment.timeline: 8 weeks to T2, 12-18 months to T3
7_validation_investment.success_threshold: Both endpoints PASS: 95% CI entirely below pass threshold (200ms, 15%)
7_validation_investment.failure_threshold: Either endpoint FAIL: 95% CI entirely above fail threshold (1000ms, 30%)

8_strategic_buyer_fit.ideal_buyer: Miethke (German precision valve manufacturer), Sophysa, or a shunt company seeking differentiation
8_strategic_buyer_fit.buyer_type: Shunt OEM seeking proportional regulation differentiator
8_strategic_buyer_fit.strategic_reason: ASD is the incumbent. P-24 offers proportional response (vs binary). If response speed and proportional control provide clinical advantage, this is a differentiated product in a commoditized market.
8_strategic_buyer_fit.capabilities_required: Hydraulic valve manufacturing, elastomer/compressible element expertise, bench testing capability, 510(k) pipeline
8_strategic_buyer_fit.why_this_buyer_would_care: The package honestly states ASD wins in 3/4 postures. But the two unestablished advantages (response speed, proportional control) are experimentally falsifiable. A buyer commissioning the $15K bench test gets a clear yes/no answer on differentiation. Low cost, high information.

10_why_now: ASD is the incumbent but has binary behavior. Proportional regulation is an unaddressed niche. $15K bench test is low-cost, high-information. Shunt companies seeking product differentiation in a flat market.
